Cases.Name: Commit publishes canonical recipes separately from directory rows
Imported provenance survives durable reads, edits and rollback without the journal
Revision conflict rolls back an earlier valid recipe in the same batch
Update creates immutable historical revision and preserves original creation time
Batch retry keeps identity and revision; changed wire with same id refuses
Real SQL trigger proves callback is a SELECT instead of input echo
Dependency blocks archive until explicitly detached at the known revision
New recipe and dependency can commit in one transaction
Read omits archived by default and IncludeArchived preserves their IDs for migration
SQL search is accent normalized and literal for percent underscore quote
Read pagination is stable and refuses a superseded snapshot
Migration marker requires every ID and rolls back the final batch on omission
Point 68: operator category is stored, read back and filterable
Point 68: an archived recipe is restored with a new revision checked by SQLite
Admission rejects altered hash, executable properties, wrong domain and metadata
Worker independently checks hash and metadata even if wire hash is recomputed
Receipt failure rolls back recipe revisions and dependencies

Limitations: Synthetic local SQLite fixtures; no AD or remote workstation; no WPF.
